findings.issue_text: `unsubscribe` dereferences `tu.notification_level` even though `TopicUser.find_by` can return `nil` for category/default-notified users, causing the unsubscribe link to return 500.

goldens.comment: logic: Potential nil pointer exception - if no TopicUser record exists, tu will be nil and calling methods on it will crash
Typo in property name: 'stopNotificiationsText' should be 'stopNotificationsText' (missing 'n' in 'Notifications')
